content: Publish path is npm Trusted Publishing via GitHub Actions OIDC — no NPM_TOKEN. @tnezdev/agentic needs its own trusted publisher registration against publish.yml before the first Agentic package publish; @tnezdev/spores had the original registration. Workflow needs permissions.id-token: write and npm >= 11.5.1. Chosen over automation tokens for no-secret-lifecycle and build provenance binding to exact workflow+repo+ref.
